import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the database
conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-080.sqlite')

# Get list of tables
tables = pd.read_sql("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';", conn)
print("Tables in database:")
print(tables)

# Focus on qualtrics__response table
if 'qualtrics__response' in tables['name'].values:
    # Get column info
    qualtrics_info = pd.read_sql("PRAGMA table_info(qualtrics__response);", conn)
    print("\nColumns in qualtrics__response:")
    print(qualtrics_info)
    
    # Identify numerical columns
    num_cols = qualtrics_info[qualtrics_info['type'].isin(['INTEGER', 'REAL', 'FLOAT', 'NUMERIC'])]['name'].tolist()
    print("\nNumerical columns:")
    print(num_cols)
    
    # Sample some data
    sample_data = pd.read_sql(f"SELECT {', '.join(num_cols[:5])} FROM qualtrics__response LIMIT 5;", conn)
    print("\nSample data:")
    print(sample_data)
    
    # Count of rows
    row_count = pd.read_sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualtrics__response;", conn).iloc[0,0]
    print(f"\nTotal rows: {row_count:,}")
    
conn.close()

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load cleaned data
df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_numerical_data.csv')

# Select top correlated pairs from correlation analysis
top_pairs = [('duration_in_seconds', 'survey_progress'),
              ('value', 'duration_in_seconds'),
              ('loop_id', 'question_option_key')]

# Perform regression diagnostics for each pair
results = []
for col1, col2 in top_pairs:
    # Linear regression
    X = sm.add_constant(df[col1])
    y = df[col2]
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    
    # Residual analysis
    residuals = model.resid
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 8))
    
    # Residuals vs Fitted
    sns.scatterplot(x=model.fittedvalues, y=residuals, ax=axes[0,0])
    axes[0,0].axhline(0, color='red')
    axes[0,0].set_title('Residuals vs Fitted')
    
    # Q-Q plot
    sm.qqplot(residuals, line='s', ax=axes[0,1])
    axes[0,1].set_title('Q-Q Plot')
    
    # Residuals vs Leverage
    influence = model.get_influence()
    sns.scatterplot(x=influence.hat_matrix_diag, y=residuals, ax=axes[1,0])
    axes[1,0].axhline(0, color='red')
    axes[1,0].set_title('Residuals vs Leverage')
    
    # Residuals vs Cook's Distance
    sns.scatterplot(x=influence.cooks_distance[0], y=residuals, ax=axes[1,1])
    axes[1,1].axhline(0, color='red')
    axes[1,1].set_title('Residuals vs Cook\'s Distance')
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(f'regression_diagnostics_{col1}_vs_{col2}.png')
    plt.close()
    
    # Save results
    results.append({
        'pair': f"{col1} vs {col2}",
        'R2': model.rsquared,
        'slope': model.params[1],
        'intercept': model.params[0],
        'residual_normality': sm.stats.diagnostic.normal_ad(residuals),
        'heteroskedasticity': sm.stats.diagnostic.het_breuschpagan(residuals, model.model.exog)[1]
    })

# Save results
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
results_df.to_csv('regression_diagnostics.csv', index=False)
print("Regression diagnostics saved to files")
